title: nan
authors: Kanwal A.; Anjum Z.; Muhammad W.
key_contribution: Proposes a visual SLAM algorithm for driverless cars in GPS-denied urban areas using monocular visual odometry, RANSAC, and global pose estimation, achieving 95% accuracy.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
